name: 蓝蝶鲨
evolution: 风铃鲨 → 蓝蝶鲨 Lv.20 → 彩蝶鲨 Lv.40 → 神谕鲨
evolutionEn: Fenglingsha → Landiesha Lv.20 → Caidiesha Lv.40 → Shenyusha
description: 它的身体构造至今难以完全解释：体内几乎都是水，身体被一层透明的膜包裹住，里面的液体非常轻。飞行时，由于压力变化或者风势太大，液体有时会漏出来。
descriptionEn: Its body structure is still hard to fully explain: it is almost entirely water inside, wrapped in a transparent membrane, and the liquid inside is very light. When flying, due to pressure changes or strong winds, the liquid sometimes leaks out.

skills.name: 甩水
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。

skills.name: 风隐
skills.description: 敌方和自己均脱离，先手-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Both enemy and self disengage, priority -1.

skills.name: 回旋风暴
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 借用
skills.description: 每回合随机变成己方队伍中其他精灵的技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn randomly becomes a skill of another spirit in the ally team.

skills.name: 落雨
skills.description: 将天气改为雨天，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Changes weather to Rainy, lasting 8 turns.

skills.name: 水炮
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次使用后，本技能能耗永久-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; after each use, this skill's energy cost permanently -1.

skills.name: 盐水浴
skills.description: 自己获得全技能能耗-2，应对防御：改为技能能耗-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains -2 to all skill energy cost; counter defense: changes to -3 skill energy cost.

skills.name: 天洪
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：本技能能耗永久-6。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; counter state: this skill's energy cost permanently -6.
